description: A red cup sits near the back left, with a yellow bottle behind it, and a yellow cup in front while a blue sponge cloth is in the hands. The left hand steadies the yellow cup as the right hand presses the blue sponge against it and rubs in short back-and-forth strokes, rotating and tilting the cup slightly to wipe different sides before setting the yellow cup down to the right and leaving the sponge on the table near the center.
